related.title: Erlang：actor mailbox 與選擇性接收
related.titleEn: Erlang: actor mailboxes and selective receive
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付channel-trace.csv及關閉責任表；教學事件模型不承諾Go排程公平性。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver channel-trace.csv and close ownership; the event model makes no scheduler-fairness guarantee. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 逐次掃描並標match、retain；第一次B掃2筆，第二次在剩餘佇列掃3筆。
related.differenceEn: Trace each scan as match or retain; the first B needs two checks and the second needs three in the remaining queue.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
channel傳遞與同步關聯，buffer容量限制未消費項目；關閉是發送方生命周期事件，不是任意一個consumer的清理捷徑。
本課數值核對：5-2 = 3 items；另一項核對：3+1 = 4 items。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

actor以訊息互動；selective receive可略過不符合的訊息而保留它們。mailbox長度與已匹配數不同。
本課數值核對：5-2 = 3 messages；另一項核對：2+3 = 5 scan_steps。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Channels couple communication and synchronization; capacity bounds unconsumed values. Closing belongs to sender lifecycle, not arbitrary consumer cleanup.
Numeric audit: 5-2 = 3 items; second audit: 3+1 = 4 items. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Actors communicate by messages; selective receive can skip unmatched messages while retaining them. Mailbox length differs from matched count.
Numeric audit: 5-2 = 3 messages; second audit: 2+3 = 5 scan_steps. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
